name: linux_string_get_size_return_length
prompt: Backport the Linux v6.7 `string_get_size()` API improvement onto this v6.6 tree. Change `string_get_size()` so it returns the number of characters that would have been written, matching `snprintf()` semantics, while preserving existing formatting and truncation behavior. Update the public declaration and add or adjust focused tests if appropriate.
